## not-converging

Escalation: not converging. Actions: retry, accept, amend, stop. Decide non-person-only actions directly with decide_escalation and your note; explicit retries may extend rounds. Person-only actions need ask_person: one question, exactly one recommended choice, proposed reason where required; the owner's pick decides directly. Findings: fnd_1, fnd_2. Their criteria remain unmet after consecutive fixes, or fixes keep causing new blockers. Another fixer needs your direction: retry says how to fix differently. Accept needs the person's risk acceptance, and amend needs the person's intended behaviour replacing the named criteria, as a noted choice or their own words.
